text:
tara: Heads up folks, the NextJS starter that demos LlamaIndex streaming is making duplicate embedding calls on initial load in the hybrid demo. Anyone run into this? :confused:
kevin: Saw similar in a customer PoC. Could be SSR + client hydration both invoking the same indexing pipeline.
mei: Can you paste the simplest repro steps?
tara: Repo: github.com/redwood-inference/next-starter-llama stream-branch. Steps: npm i, NEXT_PUBLIC_REDWOOD_KEY set, npm run dev, open /docs. On first load two POST /v1/embeddings and two index builds in the logs.
kevin: Paste of combined logs: 

2025-03-10T15:02:11Z INFO indexer: start job=build-1
2025-03-10T15:02:11Z DEBUG embeddings: req=R1 input=page_text
2025-03-10T15:02:11Z DEBUG embeddings: req=R2 input=page_text
2025-03-10T15:02:11Z INFO indexer: finish job=build-1

tara: R1 and R2 payloads identical but different ids.
mei: Is the starter using getServerSideProps + a client effect? Hybrid pages will re-run on the client sometimes.
tara: Yes, server precomputes and client streams incremental updates. We expected SDK to coalesce identical concurrent embedding requests but JS SDK currently doesn't.
kevin: Short-term I added a tiny dedupe wrapper in samples/lib/embeds.ts (map of inflight keys) and updated README. Works locally.
ash: Logger shows that even when dedupe is used, the auth refresh routine can race and perform two refresh attempts because both SSR and client instantiate separate SDK clients without shared refresh state.
mei: That's a parity gap with python SDK which has coalescing and single-refresh behavior in a process. Two asks: 1) Add request coalescing for embeddings to JS SDK; 2) Ensure single-inflight auth refresh per client instance (mutex).
tara: I've opened a PR in the sample adding the dedupe and a Playwright test asserting only one POST to /v1/embeddings on initial full load: https://github.com/redwood-inference/next-starter-llama/pull/21
kevin: I'll file SDK issue with repro and logs. sdk-bot: New issue created: SDK-712 - js-sdk: add embedding coalescing + auth refresh mutex (https://tracker.redwood.ai/SDK-712) :rocket:
mei: For DX docs, add a note under "Hybrid pages" recommending either server-only indexing or client-only streaming with dedupe, and mark this as a known parity gap.
ash: Thanks everyone. Once SDK fix lands we can revert the in-sample hack. Closing loop for now. :thumbsup:
